name: MdkWordmark
description: MDK wordmark — the canonical brand lockup, rendered as inline SVG so it tints to `currentColor`. Use this in `<AppHeader>` (via the `logo` slot) or anywhere else the brand should appear

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the wordmark. `sm` ≈ 24px tall, `md` ≈ 32px, `lg` ≈ 64px

props.name: className
props.description: Optional class hook on the outer `<svg>`
